description: This file defines the EventNativeCodeProducer class responsible for generating native C code for events and event adapters based on Java wrappers and templates within the project. It handles creating header and source files for event codes, encode/decode functions, and event adapters, integrating templates and processing event wrapper metadata.

classes.name: EventNativeCodeProducer
classes.description: Class responsible for generating native C code files for events and event adapters based on templates and event metadata within the project.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to generate event-related source and header files (both for events and adapters). Returns true if successful.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile
methods.description: Override method that is not applicable for native event generation; returns false.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Override method that is not applicable for native event generation; returns null.

methods.name: generateNativeEventHeader
methods.description: Generates the C header file for event codes, enums, and type definitions based on templates and event metadata.

methods.name: generateNativeEventSource
methods.description: Generates the C source file implementing the event encode/decode functions.

methods.name: generateNativeEventAdapterHeader
methods.description: Generates the C header file for event adapters, including listener typedefs and registration functions.

methods.name: generateNativeEventAdapterSource
methods.description: Generates the C source implementing event handlers and listener notification functions.

methods.name: getEventCodeCaseStatement
methods.description: Builds a switch-case statement for decoding event codes to corresponding sections.

methods.name: appendCodes
methods.description: Formats a list of code definitions into C #define statements with comments.
